mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_place (project_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, latitude, longitude, thumbnail) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{googlePlaceId}, #{placeName}, #{placeAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{thumbnail})
mapper.select: SELECT project_id as projectId, place_id as placeId, google_place_id as googlePlaceId, place_name as placeName, place_address as placeAddress, latitude, longitude FROM project_place WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.delete: DELETE from project_place WHERE place_id=#{placeId} and project_id=#{projectId}
